# TRADE HUSTL3

> Skilled-trades career resources and a resume builder from TRADE HUSTL3 LLC.

## Start here
- [Career hub](https://tradehustl3.com/): Explore free resources and career tools.
- [Resource Center](https://tradehustl3.com/resources): Trade and credential resources.
- [Trade Explorer](https://tradehustl3.com/resume-examples): Trade families and resume examples.
- [Credential Center](https://tradehustl3.com/resources/certifications): Certifications, licenses, and training linked to official issuers.
- [Free Top 10 Trades guide](https://tradehustl3.com/top-10-trades): Email-delivered career guide.
- [The book](https://tradehustl3.com/book): TRADE HUSTL3 by Da Maintenance Mane.

## Resume Builder
Preview starts with email verification. A $9.99 one-time purchase unlocks resume and matching cover-letter PDF and DOCX files. Use current product terms for details.
- [Terms](https://tradehustl3.com/terms)
- [Refund policy](https://tradehustl3.com/resume-builder/refund-policy)
- [AI disclosure](https://tradehustl3.com/resume-builder/ai-disclosure)
